messages:
marta: quick ping — PR #2589 has a tiny rename (Config -> ServerConfig) + a docstring tweak in pkg/server. should be safe, but `gofmt` updated a generated file under vendor. planning to merge in tomorrow's 11:00 UTC merge slot unless anyone objects.

jin: can you paste the rename diff? quick glance would help.

marta: diff is literally one type rename and comment change:
```
- type Config struct {
+ type ServerConfig struct {
    Addr string
}
```
also updated comment on StartServer. the problematic change was vendor/gen.go formatting from running `gofmt` accidentally. ci is failing fmt-check: `make fmt` shows vendor/gen.go has whitespace changes.

samuel: quick +1 on the rename itself, but let's avoid touching vendor. if vendor/gen.go is regenerated by tooling we should revert it from the PR. run `git checkout -- vendor/gen.go` and force-push the fix.

ci-bot: build/format check failed on PR #2589 — fmt-check. details: https://ci.redwood/2589

elaine: @marta can you re-run `git checkout -- vendor/gen.go` and push a small fixup? I can approve after that.

marta: will do now. planning a quick fixup and push in ~10m.

samuel: also could you add a one-line changelog note in docs/CHANGELOG.md: `refactor: rename Config -> ServerConfig (pkg/server)` — helps us track breaking-ish renames. non-blocking but nice.

marta: added changelog entry and dropped vendor change, force-pushed. ran `gofmt` locally; fmt check passes here.

ci-bot: build/format check passed on PR #2589 — fmt-check.

elaine: reviewing now. small comment nit: StartServer signature still uses `cfg` var name in a couple callsites, could rename to `sc` for consistency or just leave as `cfg` — tiny nit, not blocking.

elaine: approving :white_check_mark:

marta: thanks all! merging in the 11:00 UTC slot unless someone flags anything before then.
